The fitting and numerical routines introduce further correctness failures. The evaluation comprises one loss table on five small UCI datasets, without runtime or memory measurements, scaling experiments, direct comparisons with exact solvers, or independent optimality verification. Preprocessing, baseline hyperparameters, handling of violations of general position, and train/test protocols are unspecified.
